items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: The interviewer mentions Charlie Barnet in the context of Woody Herman's influences; the interviewee (Sam Jones) does not respond or provide any personal connection to Charlie Barnet.

ctx.x: I alread come down to the Vanguard one night and light the fire on Miles.

Right. That man was fantastic, man. See all those people man and those bands. Where do you think that Woody Herman got his idea of having a jazz band man. He got this stuff from Charlie Barnet. All these styles man come from all those bands recalled you know.
